v4.6.98 — Update loop FIXED (Windows-on-ARM)

🔁 THE LOOP
• On ARM64 Windows, the updater killed the running app with `taskkill /F`, which fails there with “operation not supported” for the emulated APEX.exe. So the app was never closed: it kept its files locked, the installer couldn’t replace the version bundle, the app relaunched at the OLD version, and the updater offered the same update again — forever (the version was frozen at 4.6.95 across every relaunch).
• Now the app is closed with PowerShell Stop-Process (the same call Task Manager uses — it works on ARM), and the installer waits for it to fully exit before copying. Both the in-app updater and the installer itself were fixed.

✅ After this update installs once, the loop is gone for good.

Update via the in-app banner.
